body.purpose: Descriptions, empty states, list copy at 0.875-1rem.

tag.purpose: Status stamps and datelines in tracked uppercase Open Sans.

dos: Do stamp every state as a word first (Pending Review, Approved, Suppressed) with tabular counts beside it.
Do number sequences that carry process (seasons 01-09) so position is explicit; never number page sections.
Do theme landing browser surfaces from the palette: blue-tinted selection, blue caret, blue focus rings, 3px underline offset, tabular numerals.
Do keep controls named as actions (Review, Get started, Open the gate) with the primary action on the first undecided tray.
Do author demonstration data at full fidelity and label it synthetic; never invent testimonials, customers, benchmarks, or pricing.
Do set logos plain in black or white with clear margins; never recolor, rotate, outline, or stack them.
donts: Don't rebuild the uniform icon-plus-heading stat-card grid; the bench and ledgers own summary data.
Don't use kickers above headings, gradient text, glass, side stripes, hard offset shadows, or emoji/glyph icons.
Don't set tags or body copy in monospace, and don't use a non-Open-Sans display face as the display voice.
Don't place heritage green/serif Trial Grounds atoms (leaf buttons, kraft tags, sprout seals) inside an Open Lab composition.
Don't use red for decoration or story backgrounds; red is failed/needs-action only.
keyCharacteristics: Committed blue owns regions (rail, close, primary action), never scattered accents.
Word-first stamps (Pending Review, Approved, Suppressed); single red reserved for failed/needs-action only.
Outline brand shapes with semi-transparent fills as the only decoration, repeatable as patterns.
One authored moment per visit — the stamp-lift on the first tray — everything else instant.
narrative.overview: The bench is a white lab table, not a claim wall. Pending work waits in a review queue, the owner clears the approved forward, and the suppressed is set aside where it can never be recommended. One committed blue carries whole regions — rails, close field, primary actions — while black ink carries structure and tint tags stamp every state as a word first. Official horizontal logos sit plain in black on light and white on blue or black, with no effects, rotation, or containing shapes.

rules.body: Blue owns whole regions (rail, close, primary action). Accents scattered over white ground are drift, not the system.
rules.name: The Committed Blue Rule

rules.body: Only failed or needs-action is red. Everything else resolves to ink, blue, or soft.
rules.name: The Single-Red Rule

rules.body: Every state ships as an uppercase word (Pending Review, Approved, Suppressed); color backs the word, never replaces it.
rules.name: The Stamp Before Color Rule

rules.body: No eyebrow label above a heading, ever. The heading speaks first.
rules.name: The No Kicker Rule

rules.body: Monospace is for code, data, and measurement only — never body copy, never decorative voice. Tags speak in tracked Open Sans caps, not mono.
rules.name: The Mono Measures Rule

rules.body: Headlines are mixed case and as large as they need to be. All-caps is for tags and the logo asset, never headlines.
rules.name: The Mixed Case Rule

rules.body: Shadows carry an offset and a soft blur. A zero-offset colored halo is decoration, and this world ships none.
rules.name: The Offset Depth Rule
